about: Hand-written context for board entries, read by rentfrontier.leaderboard. Annotations never change a score, the ranking or the frontier.

m8-drift/desc-v1/gibbs@b7c196f: Fit on a Modal H100 (NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3): 16 chains x (900 warmup + 2,000 draws), 3,368 s including JIT (warmup 851 s, sampling 2,515 s), about $4.11. Gate: max split R-hat 1.006, min bulk ESS 2,573, all-effects R-hat 1.02 from exact per-chain moments.

Not refit locally (Ben, 2026-09-24): the design and its settings were tuned for an H100, and thelio's RTX 2060 runs float64 at about 1/32 rate. Its fit time on this board is H100 time; the thelio fit time is unmeasured, so it is not the local baseline for fit-time work.

Sampler check: the Gibbs-vs-NUTS agreement test for the drift design (tdrift) passes against the non-centred reference (unit_drift_scale sd ratio 0.98-1.05 over two seeds; PR #17 review). The old xfail came from a centred reference. The margin is thin (Gibbs ESS on unit_drift_scale about 80-200 in the test).
m8-drift/base-v1/gibbs@b7c196f: Fit on a Modal H100: 16 chains x (900 + 2,000), 3,269 s including JIT, about $3.99. Not refit locally (Ben, 2026-09-24); the thelio fit time is unmeasured.
m5-nocurves/unitdesc-v1/gibbs@ab2a7df+un: Serves the app (Ben, 2026-09-29): the 2 x (300 + 3600) fit m5-nocurves-unitdesc-v1-rows-ab2a7df-gibbs-2060-3600-ul1, through its summary (rentfrontier.summary at efdfc7c) on the listings site. The 2 x (300 + 3000) fit of the same design failed on sigma and does not serve. From 2026-09-26 the app served m0q-btrend/unitdesc-v1/nuts@df5dacb+unit-labels-v1.

footer: Each hardware class has its own table, frontier and best: a fit time only competes with fit times on the same hardware (where the fit ran). Modal H100/H200 times are not comparable with thelio's.
